test_command: cd /workspace/repo && bundle exec ruby -Itest /workspace/repo/test/unit/gateways/datatrans_test.rb --runner=xml 2>&1 | bundle exec ruby -e "require 'rexml/document'; input=STDIN.read; doc=REXML::Document.new(input); results=[]; doc.elements.each('stream/test-result') do |r|; name=r.elements['test/name'].text; status=r.elements['result/status'].text; results<<[name,status]; end; puts '<testsuite>'; results.each{|n,s| if s=='success'; puts %(<testcase classname=\"DatatransTest\" name=\"#{n}\"/>); else; puts %(<testcase classname=\"DatatransTest\" name=\"#{n}\"><failure/></testcase>); end}; puts '</testsuite>'"
